preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The target points k must be between 0 and 100,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(all(gcd(a[i], a[i+1]) == k for i in range(0, len(a)-1, 2)) for a in permutations(range(1, n+1))) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid sequence of n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: All integers in the output sequence must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The output sequence must contain n distinct integers.
